entry_mode_text: Market at the daily-open anchor 07:00 UK = 09:00 broker (UTC+3, BST = UK+2). The fill level is the reference close of the last completed cash session strictly before the report date: 7,546.40 on Tue 14 Jul 2026. That close stands in as a proxy for the unobserved 07:00 UK open and is disclosed as such. Signed gap entry minus reference close = 0.00 points, as a MARKET card requires.
management_text: Three equal units. Unit 1 exits at TP1 7,604.7 (entry +1R, +58.3 pts). Unit 2 exits at TP2 7,663.0 (entry +2R, +116.6 pts); on the Unit 2 fill the Unit 3 stop moves to entry +0.2R = 7,558.1 (+11.7 pts). Unit 3 runs to the session-close time-stop or to the 3xATR14 price cap at 7,773.7 (+227.3 pts), whichever triggers first. R = 58.3 pts = 0.77 x ATR14, so no wide-stop flag is due; 2R = 116.6 pts is inside 3 x ATR14 = 227.3, so no ambitious-TP2 flag is due. Thesis invalidation, distinct from the stop: a daily close below 7,472.8 (prior-session daily S3), 15.3 pts beyond the stop = 0.20 x ATR14. Caveats: prior-session intraday H/L are single-source indicative, so the pivot levels cited as confluences carry the indicative qualifier; the entry price is a prior-close proxy for the anchor open; the holding period collides with the 15 Jul PPI print and the Fed-chair testimony, both high-impact on the scheduled calendar.
rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE. The last completed primary-asset session strictly before D (2026-07-15) is Tue 14 Jul 2026. On the report's own declared price basis (cash regular session, 09:30-16:00 ET = 16:30-23:00 broker) that session's settled close is 7,546.40. Every level below is built on that one number. The report body prints 7,543.59 for the same close; the slice cash close is 7,546.40 (delta -2.81, inside the 3-point close tolerance but not identical), and the rule that a MARKET entry equals the reference close means the entry moves to the slice value, not the report's. BASIS AND ATR14. ATR14 = 75.77 index points, 14 sessions ending 14 Jul 2026, computed on cash-session bars (16:30-23:00 broker) with TR = max(H-L, |H-prevC|, |L-prevC|). The same figure is used for every buffer, cap, tier and flag on this card. The full-broker-day basis (00:00-23:45) gives 83.42; the cash basis is used because the report defines the instrument as the cash index over the NYSE/NASDAQ regular session and excludes pre/after-market. The report never states ATR14 as a number and implies two different values (78.5 from its 3xATR cap, ~70 from its backtest bands); both are discarded. DIRECTION. Regime label TRANSITION (Kaufman trending-up vs a negative volatility slope, dual-gate fall-through) with a directional conviction score of +0.42, above the 0.25 conviction threshold, so LONG and not suppressed. ENTRY. Market at the 07:00 UK anchor = 09:00 broker; fill = reference close 7,546.40. STOP. Tighter of (a) 5-day swing low 7,421.10 (session low of Wed 08 Jul 2026, inside the 5-session block 08-14 Jul) less a 0.25 x ATR14 buffer = 7,421.10 - 18.94 = 7,402.16, and (b) nearest support in the 5-day structure, the session low of Mon 13 Jul 2026 at 7,507.00, less the same buffer = 7,507.00 - 18.94 = 7,488.06, rounded on the price grid to 7,488.1. (b) is tighter, so stop = 7,488.1. The report anchored this stop on 7,503.0, which is the derived-CFD indicative low for 13 Jul; the slice cash low for that session is 7,507.00, which moves the stop up 4.7 points. The 14 Jul low 7,512.9 sits in the same shelf but the report's own support narrative names the 13 Jul low, so 7,507.00 is the anchor used. R = 7,546.40 - 7,488.1 = 58.3 points = 0.77 x ATR14, inside the 3.5 x ATR14 structural cap of 265.2 and inside the 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band of 22.73-227.31. TARGETS. TP1 = entry + 1R = 7,604.7; TP2 = entry + 2R = 7,663.0; on the TP2 fill the Unit 3 stop moves to entry + 0.2R = 7,558.1. TP3 = the runner's 3 x ATR14 price cap = 7,546.40 + 227.31 = 7,773.7, taken in preference to a null so the record and the card carry one value; the session-close time-stop applies first if it triggers first. TP1 sits 58.3 points from entry, well inside the 2.5 x ATR14 reachability band of 189.4. PIVOTS. Floor-trader formula P = (H+L+C)/3 on the prior period's high, low and close; the prior period for the daily set is the D-1 cash session of 14 Jul 2026 (H 7,559.70 / L 7,512.90 / C 7,546.40), giving P 7,539.67, R1 7,566.43, R2 7,586.47, R3 7,613.23, S1 7,519.63, S2 7,492.87, S3 7,472.83. The report built its daily set from 13 Jul (D-2) and is not used. Weekly, from the prior week 06-10 Jul cash (H 7,579.50 / L 7,421.10 / C 7,574.20): P 7,524.93, R1 7,628.77, S1 7,470.37. CONFLUENCES. Entry 7,546.40 sits 6.73 points above daily P 7,539.67 = 0.09 x ATR14, inside the 0.15 x ATR14 confluence tolerance - a balance-point confluence. TP1 7,604.7 sits 8.53 points below daily R3 7,613.23 = 0.11 x ATR14, also inside tolerance. The report's claim that TP1 is near daily R2 is not carried: R2 on the corrected prior period is 7,586.47, 18.2 points away. Stop 7,488.1 has no pivot inside tolerance; its anchor is the 13 Jul session low. NO FIB LEVELS are cited on this card - the fib swing anchor is a Trade 3A/3B input and neither variant is active in this regime. INVALIDATION. A daily close below daily S3 7,472.83, a named structural level, 15.3 points beyond the stop (0.20 x ATR14, more than the 0.15 x ATR14 minimum separation).

management_text: SUPPRESSED - in TRANSITION only a breakout-side entry is permitted, and the momentum-breakout card that identifies which side that is is itself ineligible, so there is no side to trade. The pivot tier itself is CORROBORATED, recomputed from the broker price series. No units, no break-even rule, no runner.
rationale: RE-EVALUATED IN THE CORROBORATION CORRECTION PASS. This record was rebuilt because the pivot-corroboration gate had been applied to a tier the gate was never meant to cover. That gate exists to stop a card being built on prior-period high and low that cannot be established - narrative or aggregator quotes. It does not reach a tier struck from the broker price series the resulting order would be filled and settled against: that series is the settlement source, not a secondary quote about the market, so a tier computed from it is corroborated by construction and there is nothing for a second source to corroborate it against. PIVOT TIER, RECOMPUTED AND FLAGGED. The daily floor-trader tier is recomputed directly from the broker price series held for this run - the US500 15-minute series in data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-07-14.csv, last bar 2026-07-14 23:45:00, which is the execution and settlement source for this instrument - on the declared cash regular session basis, 16:30-23:00 broker = 09:30-16:00 ET. Prior period: the cash regular session of Tue 14 Jul 2026, H 7,559.70 / L 7,512.90 / C 7,546.40. P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7,539.67; R1 7,566.43, R1.5 7,576.45, R2 7,586.47, R3 7,613.23; S1 7,519.63, S2 7,492.87, S3 7,472.83. Weekly, from the prior week 06-10 Jul on the same series and session: P 7,524.93, R1 7,628.77, S1 7,470.37. CORROBORATION FLAG: CORROBORATED. Series named: the broker US500 15-minute price series above. Session named: the cash regular session of Tue 14 Jul 2026. The report's blanket statement that every tier is single-source indicative described a different and weaker input - the derived quote feed its own tables were built from - and is not inherited here. The single-source-indicative suppression trigger is therefore TESTED AND NOT FIRED, and the suppression recorded on the superseded version of this record is withdrawn. SUPPRESSED ON A DIFFERENT AND INDEPENDENT GROUND. Regime label for this date is TRANSITION, the same label carried by the other records for 2026-07-15. In TRANSITION the only permitted pivot trade is a breakout-side entry, and the side is the one the momentum-breakout card identifies; a limit on the counter side is suppressed rather than re-labelled, because placing one would front-run that card and contradict the regime read. The momentum-breakout card for this date is itself ineligible. The 25-session range on the same series and session basis, over the 25 sessions ending 14 Jul 2026, is high 7,583.40 (Mon 15 Jun 2026) to low 7,260.00 (Thu 11 Jun 2026), width 323.40 points. A confirmed break requires a daily close beyond a boundary by at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 0.25 x 75.77 = 18.94 points, i.e. at or above 7,602.34 on the upside or at or below 7,241.06 on the downside. The reference close of 7,546.40 is 55.94 points short of the upside trigger and 305.34 points above the downside trigger, so neither boundary is broken. TRIGGER FIRED: no breakout side is available in TRANSITION, because the momentum-breakout card that would identify it is ineligible for want of a confirmed break. VALUE THAT FIRED IT: reference close 7,546.40 against the required confirming close of 7,602.34, short by 55.94 points. With no identified breakout side there is no permitted entry, so the card is emitted as a suppressed row with no entry, stop, R or ladder. A card is not forced into existence by borrowing the counter side. SECOND, INDEPENDENT ARITHMETIC CONFIRMATION. Even if the breakout-branch geometry were borrowed from the trend branch it mirrors - which the regime rule does not permit - that geometry is rule-fixed and carries no free parameter: entry P + 0.10 x (R1 - P) = 7,539.67 + 0.10 x 26.76 = 7,542.35, stop P - 0.8 x (P - S1) = 7,539.67 - 0.8 x 20.04 = 7,523.64, giving R = 18.71 points = 0.25 x ATR14. That falls below the 0.3 x ATR14 floor of 22.73 points and outside the 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band of 22.73-227.31; the rule for a ratio outside that band is rebuild, not warn, and with no free parameter in either formula there is nothing to rebuild. Separately, the pivot targets invert against any breakout entry: R1 7,566.43, R1.5 7,576.45 and R2 7,586.47 sit at or barely above the 7,583.40 boundary a breakout entry would first have to clear, and all three sit below the 7,602.34 confirming close. PRIOR ORDER-SIDE OBJECTION, WITHDRAWN. The superseded version of this record also held, as a secondary point, that the entry sat on the wrong side of the reference close. That objection does not survive re-checking. The branch permits a stop or a limit at the same level, and a buy limit is required to sit at or below the reference close. At 7,542.35 - a signed gap of -4.05 points against the reference close of 7,546.40 - a buy limit sits on the correct side; only the order type changes, from a buy stop to a buy limit. The order-side rule is satisfied and is not a ground for suppression on this date. REFERENCE CLOSE, VOLATILITY AND REGIME, unchanged from the other records for this date. Reference close 7,546.40, the settled close of the last completed cash regular session strictly before the report date, Tue 14 Jul 2026, session 16:30-23:00 broker. ATR14 = 75.77 index points over the 14 cash regular sessions ending at that close, TR = max(H-L, |H-prevC|, |L-prevC|); the full-broker-day basis gives 83.42 and is not used, because the instrument is the cash index over the regular session. Regime label TRANSITION. Anchor 07:00 UK = 09:00 broker, unchanged from the fixed instance value; it is not re-selected at run time. No level fields are populated.
